blocks: Kāneʻohe lies mostly in {geo:house:049}, which is the House district covering most of the town. Smaller parts fall in {geo:house:050} and {geo:house:048}. The town is entirely within {geo:county:15003}, and most of it lies in {geo:senate:024}.
caveats: Because Kāneʻohe spans several House districts, a single district is the one that covers most of the town, not the whole town.
